text.사용자 입력·모델 응답·도구 호출/결과·서브에이전트 위임/결과·MCP·h: Turns user input, model replies, tool calls and results, subagent delegations and results, MCP and hook rows into events. Special handling of tool names and the mapping of rows such as hooks are settings data.
text.JSON 포인터 → 글롭(`*`·`?`, 목록이면 그중 하나). 모두 맞: JSON pointer → glob (`*`, `?`; a list means any one of them). All must match. Booleans and numbers are compared as JSON strings (`true`). A missing value doesn't match.
text.초안 필드 → JSON 포인터. category·status·stage는: Draft field → JSON pointer. category, status and stage values can be mapped with value_maps (category falls back to the default category when not in the map).
Evidence name → JSON pointer (only when there is a value).
Part to use as detail (empty string = the whole row).
text.false면 이 행의 원문을 색인에 넣지 않는다. detail·raw에는: If false, the original of this row isn't put in the index. detail and raw keep only the keep values and omitted (bytes = UTF-8 byte count of the key-sorted JSON, sha256 = its hash), so search doesn't match the original either. Title, fields, evidence and summary are read from the original (don't put body pointers in templates).
text.store_raw가 false일 때 원문에서 남길 JSON 포인터(같은: JSON pointers to keep from the original when store_raw is false (kept at the same location). The summary is written from these values and omitted.
text.목록 요약으로 쓸 평문(detail 기준 포인터 또는 `{/포인터}` 틀: Plain text to use as the list summary (a pointer relative to detail or a `{/pointer}` template; the first one from the front that yields text). If empty, the whole detail as a string.
text.`/`로 시작하고 `{/`가 없으면 JSON 포인터(빈 문자열 = det: Starting with `/` and without `{/`, a JSON pointer (empty string = the whole detail); otherwise a template: `{/pointer}` is replaced by its value (string, text block, number or boolean), `{/pointer|keys}` by the object key list (`, `), and `{/pointer|count}` by the number of list or object items. A template is used only when every placeholder has a value (a template without placeholders is literal text).
Category id to emit per row kind (an id of the classification, open string).
text.행 종류별로 덧붙일 태그(도구 이벤트에는 코어 약속 태그 `tool`이: Tags to add per row kind (tool events always get the core tag `tool`).
text.서브에이전트에 일을 넘기는 도구. 대상 thread는 출처가 서브에이전트: Tools that hand work to a subagent. The target thread is the value the source found in the subagent metadata, otherwise fallback_target (`{value}` = the target_pointer value).
text.도구 결과 행의 이 포인터에 서브에이전트 id가 있으면 위임 결과(fro: If this pointer in a tool result row holds a subagent id, the row is treated as a delegation result (from = the subagent thread).
Subagent id → thread (same as the source's file name agent-<id>.jsonl).
text.호출 이벤트에 문서(경로·action)를 붙인다. 실제 성공 여부는 같은: Attaches a document (path, action) to the call event. Whether it actually succeeded is taken from the status of the result event with the same call_id.
text.파일 이름 또는 경로 글롭(`*`·`?`, `*`는 `/`도 넘음, 예:: File name or path glob (`*`, `?`; `*` also crosses `/`, e.g. */.claude/rules/*.md) → document kind. File names first, then longer globs first. Otherwise default_document_kind.
text.근거 이름 → JSON 포인터. 행에 값이 있으면 그 행에서 나온 모든: Evidence name → JSON pointer. If the row has a value, the evidence is added to every event from that row (evidence an event already has is kept). Default: requestRef of the reply row (the api-request record id of the same row) → request_id.
text.자리 표시 {server}·{tool}(각각 한 번)과 *(아무 글자)로: Name template written with the placeholders {server} and {tool} (once each) and * (any characters). Tool calls whose whole name matches become MCP calls. An empty string means MCP isn't treated separately.
text.세션 제목에서 뺄 입력: Input to leave out of session titles
text.이 접두사로 시작하는 사용자 입력은 세션 제목 후보로 보지 않는다(명령: User input starting with these prefixes isn't considered as a session title candidate (command markers and so on).
text.사용자 입력을 세션 제목 후보로: User input as session title candidate
text.끄면 사용자 입력에 session_title 태그를 붙이지 않는다. 그러: When off, user input doesn't get the session_title tag. Then only candidates tagged by row rules (default: custom-title and ai-title rows) become session titles. The session title is picked by the core's session title ranking rules (data) — default: last session_title.renamed (custom-title) > last session_title.generated (ai-title) > first session_title (input).
text.행 종류(categories와 같은 이름)별로 목록 요약에 쓸 평문의 위: Location of the plain text for the list summary per row kind (same names as categories): a JSON pointer relative to the event detail or a `{/pointer}` template, the first one from the front that yields text. A string value is used as is; a list of content blocks has its text blocks joined. If nothing matches, the whole detail is used as a string. The original stays in detail and raw.
Content blocks of these types don't have their body stored (only a mark that they existed).
Checked before row_rules (to add rules without editing the default ones).
text.사용자·응답 행 해석보다 먼저 보는 선언형 대응(hook·attachme: Declarative mappings checked before user and reply rows are interpreted (hook, attachment, system, progress and so on). The first matching rule wins. A row that matches no rule and is not a user or reply row is kept as is under categories.other.
text.Claude Code가 남긴 세션 기록(서브에이전트 포함)을 읽는다. 원: Reads the session records Claude Code leaves (subagents included). The originals are only read; the index gets a copy with suspected secret values masked.
text.더 이상 읽지 않는다. 로그는 앱에 등록된 프로젝트 전체(하위 폴더 포함: No longer read. Logs read the sessions of every project registered in the app (subfolders included). With no registered projects, nothing is read.
text.세션 파일 한 줄(JSON)에서 작업 폴더를 꺼내는 JSON 포인터. 폴: JSON pointer that takes the run folder from one line (JSON) of the session file. When the folder name equals a registered folder key or looks like a folder under it, this value decides which project the session belongs to.
text.Claude Code 기록 형식이 바뀌어 작업 폴더 필드 이름이 달라졌을: Change this when the Claude Code record format changes and the run folder field has a different name.
text.작업 폴더를 찾을 앞부분 크기: Bytes to scan for the run folder
Maximum bytes read from the start of the file to find the session run folder.
text.프로젝트 폴더 이름에 남길 글자: Characters to keep in project folder names
text.작업 폴더 경로에서 영문자·숫자와 이 글자만 남기고 나머지는 바꿈 글자로: Builds the session folder name from the run folder path by keeping letters, digits and these characters and replacing the rest with the replacement character (e.g. /work/demo → -work-demo).
Characters other than letters, digits and the kept characters are replaced with this character.
text.앱이 실행한 세션 폴더(앱 작업 공간 기준). 기본은 구독 자격 폴더 아: Folder of sessions run by the app (relative to the app workspace). By default it's under the subscription credentials folder; change it along with the execution backend's credentials folder.
No longer read. Use the app run session folder field.
text.Claude Code projects 폴더 목록. 비우면 기본 루트와 앱: List of Claude Code projects folders. Leave empty to read the default root and the app run session folder. Anything outside registered projects is skipped.
text.루트 기준 상대 경로 글롭(예: */*.jsonl). 기본은 세션 파일과: Path globs relative to the root (e.g. */*.jsonl). The default is session files and subagent files.
For example, `*/*/subagents/**` to leave out subagents.
Folder to read when the root folders are empty and the config folder environment variable is not set either.
text.이 환경 변수가 있으면 그 아래 하위 경로를 기본 루트로 쓴다. 빈 문자: If this environment variable is set, the subpath under it is used as the default root. An empty string means it isn't checked.
text.설정 폴더 환경 변수가 가리키는 폴더 안에서 세션 로그가 있는 하위 폴더: Subfolder holding session logs inside the folder the config folder environment variable points to.
text.<프로젝트>/<세션>/<이 폴더>/**/agent-*.jsonl 을 서브: <project>/<session>/<this folder>/**/agent-*.jsonl is treated as subagent records.
text.agent-<id>.jsonl 옆의 agent-<id><접미사>를 읽어: Reads agent-<id><suffix> next to agent-<id>.jsonl to get the role and delegation call id.
Values to take from the metadata JSON (JSON pointers).
Where to read the subagent role (agent type).
Where to read the task description written when delegating.
Where to read the id of the tool call that called this subagent.
Metadata files larger than this aren't read.
text.켜면 기본으로 `~/.claude/projects`(환경 변수 `CLAU: When on, reads `~/.claude/projects` by default (or `projects` under `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` if that environment variable is set). List other folders in `roots`. It's off by default because conversation text is copied into the index.
